episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: Whether it's the YouTube channel where we're doing 100 families compete for $250 ,000, or it's Beast Games where they're competing for $5 million.
The $5 million, people are way more excited for.
Some of the YouTube videos, it's not as grandiose.
They're like, I don't know if I want to lose my job for a 1 % chance of winning $250 ,000.
Well, how many people, when you do Beast Games, how many people are competing?
So the newest season we just shot, we grabbed one person from every country on Earth.
So it was around 200.

pretty cool because you would put them in these crazy games and you'd see how someone from the Asian Pacific countries would react versus someone in South America and they play and think so differently because they have such different upbringings.
It was really cool.
You must have had to thoroughly vet these people, right?
Make sure they're not insane?
You have a serial killer?
We do the psych and background checks, of course.
How do you get that information if you're going...
I mean, if you have...
How many countries are there, first of all?
We went off of whatever the Olympics do.
So it's like something around 200.
Yeah, plus or minus a couple.
So some of them have to have some shitty infrastructure.
Oh, I mean, I think one of them has literally 40 ,000 people living in it.
Like it was, what is it?
Not the, something Sea Islands, not the Cayman Islands, but some island country.
And yeah, I was like, wow, like my town, which has 100 ,000 people, is two and a half times the population of your country.

Well, I was joking with the contestant because I was like if you win the five million dollars You could technically give a $200 dividend to every single person in your country is like it's that crazy That's that little people living there Wow.
